facts.business: DSM Fresh Foods Limited (formerly DSM Fresh Foods Private Limited), operating under the brand Zappfresh, is engaged in building an integrated farm-to-fork food supply chain offering fresh meats, ready-to-cook (RTC), ready-to-eat (RTE) and frozen snacks under the Meevaa Foods brand across retail, HoReCa and digital channels.

segments.name: Fresh Meat & Food Products (Zappfresh & Meevaa Foods)

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Board of Directors has a view that the Company will earn more profits in the upcoming years.

auditor.name: M/s. Harish Kumar & Associates, Practicing Company Secretaries (Secretarial Auditor); M/s. AH S G & Co. LLP, Chartered Accountants (Internal Auditor); Statutory Auditor name not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Secretarial Auditor qualified: (1) Advances to directors/related parties classified as business advances not loans, legal opinion obtained; (2) Charge creation form for debenture proceeds not filed; (3) Monitoring Agency Report for quarter ended December not filed with stock exchange; (4) Utilisation of IPO proceeds not aligned with offer document objects per Monitoring Agency Report.

key_risks: Forward-looking statements may differ materially from actual results
